articles.summary: Zevia PBC (“Zevia”) (NYSE:ZVIA), the Company that provides naturally delicious, zero sugar better-for-you beverages, today issued the following statement in response to the press release issued by Kanen Wealth Management LLC earlier today: Zevia welcomes open communication with all of its shareholders and values their input. Zevia's Board of Directors and management team regularly review the Company's strategic priorities and opportunities towards the goal of enhancing value for shareholders and the Company's other stakeholders. Zevia plans to continue to constructively engage with its shareholders, and Zevia's Board of Directors intends to review the matters raised carefully and thoughtfully. About Zevia Zevia PBC, a Delaware public benefit corporation designated as a “Certified B Corporation,” is focused on addressing the global health challenges resulting from excess sugar consumption by offering a broad portfolio of zero sugar, zero calorie, naturally sweetened beverages. articles.summary: Net Sales at the High End of Outlook; Adjusted EBITDA Exceeds Outlook Zevia PBC (“Zevia” or the “Company”) (NYSE: ZVIA), the Company bringing naturally delicious, zero sugar, clean-label beverages, today reported results for the second quarter ended June 30, 2026.
